<b>Sandcarvers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are aggressive shell plated worms that live beneath pools of shifting sand, bursting forth when movement is sensed nearby.<ref>Sandcarver Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Shell plated worm that lives beneath pools of shifting sand. Bursts forth at movement sensed close,"</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Sandcarvers act as an environmental hazard, bursting out of loose sand pits when Hornet draws near and damaging her similarly to spikes or thorns, dealing {{Damage|1}} and resetting her location to the last solid ground she occupied. Other enemies can be defeated by knocking them into Sandcarver-infested sand.

Sandcarvers can be defeated with tools such as [[Cogwork Wheel]], [[Pimpillo]], and [[Sawtooth Circlet]] to add them to the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]]; however, this does not negate the danger, since new Sandcarvers immediately spawn from the same area. {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} <i>cannot</i> kill Sandcarvers.

== Location ==
Sandcarvers can be found in sand pits in the [[Blasted Steps]] and the [[Sands of Karak]].

== Trivia ==
* While Sandcarvers do not respond to the [[Needolin]], they have the following [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Text#Sandcarver|unused Needolin text]]:
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Churning, shifting...
* Scouring wind!
* Hard bone beneath...
* Rattling, wriggling...}}
* When dead [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] land near Sandcarvers, they lash out at the dead body. Enemy corpses that land in Sandcarver pits will be consumed.
** In the case of [[Watcher at the Edge]], the [[Grey Memento]] will be spat out.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Screenshot SS Watcher at the Edge 14.png!Grey Memento spat out by Sandcarvers
}}
* Sandcarvers may release a red cloud of dust when Hornet gets devoured by them. This is only for aesthetic purpose.
